annotation.title_clean: Opinion of the European Economic and Social Committee on ‘Upgrading inclusive, secure and trustworthy digitalisation for all’ (2021/C 374/03)
annotation.title_en: Opinion of the European Economic and Social Committee on ‘Upgrading inclusive, secure and trustworthy digitalisation for all’
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, C 374/11
named_instruments_referenced: ILO Centenary Declaration for the Future of Work
Council Conclusions on Shaping Europe's Digital Future
annotation.summary_en: EESC exploratory opinion requested by the Slovenian Presidency on inclusive, secure and trustworthy digitalisation. It calls for an inclusive EU digital government policy, investment via EU funds, support for SMEs, social dialogue and a right to disconnect, stronger DSA/DMA, and better consumer protection against AI, IoT and robotics challenges. Robotics is mentioned only in passing.
key_provisions_or_claims: Recommends swift adoption of an inclusive EU digital government policy ensuring accessibility for older people, persons with disabilities and rural populations
Calls for EU funding (Just Transition Fund, Digital Europe, ERDF, ESF+) and tax credits to support businesses, especially SMEs
Calls for EU-wide recognition of a right to disconnect and social dialogue on remote work
Recommends strengthening DSA liability rules and banning dark patterns in the DMA
States that AI, IoT and robotics require strengthened consumer protection
